What it does

Declares March 30 - April 2, 2026, as AI Week in South Carolina and encourages all citizens of the Palmetto State to learn more about artificial intelligence.

Who it applies to

  • All citizens of South Carolina (resolved clause)

Effective date

not stated in the text

Key definitions

  • artificial intelligence: a technology that can mimic human intelligence to solve problems, make decisions, and generate ideas; it acts as a tool for augmenting human capabilities, rather than simply replacing them, with applications in automation, content creation, and analysis (whereas clauses)

Penalties and enforcement

not stated in the text

How it affects AI deployment

  • Creates no legal obligations or restrictions for organizations deploying AI; it is a nonbinding resolution encouraging public awareness (resolved clause)

 A house RESOLUTION 

   

 TO DECLARE MARCH 30 - APRIL 2, 2026, AS "AI WEEK" IN
THE STATE OF SOUTH CAROLINA AND TO ENCOURAGE ALL CITIZENS OF THE PALMETTO STATE
TO LEARN MORE ABOUT THIS CRITICAL TECHNOLOGY. 

   

 W hereas, the House of
Representatives has become aware that AI, or artificial intelligence, is
rapidly transforming the modern workplace by becoming essential for increasing
efficiency, for reducing routine tasks, and for expediting data-driven
decisions; and 

   

 W hereas, artificial
intelligence is a technology that can mimic human intelligence to solve
problems, make decisions, and generate ideas. It acts as a tool for augmenting
human capabilities, rather than simply replacing them, with applications in
automation, content creation, and analysis; and 

   

 W hereas, key benefits
include enhanced productivity, improved customer service, and faster learning,
making AI literacy crucial for future-ready employees; and 

   

 W hereas, in light of
AI's rising importance, during the week of March 30 - April 2, 2026, Horry-Georgetown
Technical College will celebrate AI technology under the theme "Empowering
Innovation with AI" by raising awareness of ethical and practical AI
applications, encouraging collaboration and experimentation, and recognizing
innovative ideas that advance student success and institutional effectiveness;
and 

   

 W hereas, in short,
learning to use artificial intelligence is crucial for increasing productivity,
enhancing career competitiveness, and staying relevant as AI transforms
industries by automating tasks, analyzing big data, and fueling innovation.
Moreover, excellence in using AI enables faster decision making, fosters
creativity, and helps solve complex problems, making competent use of this
technology a foundational skill for the modern workforce. Now, therefore, 

   

 B e it resolved by the House of Representatives : 

   

 T hat the members of the
South Carolina House of Representatives ,
by this resolution, declare March 30 - April 2, 2026, as "AI Week" in the State
of South Carolina and encourage all citizens of the Palmetto State to learn
more about this critical technology. 

   

 B e it further resolved
that a copy of this resolution be presented to Horry-Georgetown Technical
College.
